pack_reviewed: Private Evaluator Pack - Draft - NoSend - NoWrite - Simulation Only

clear_items.title: MachineSignal sells machine-readable commercial decisions
clear_items.detail: The pack makes clear that the operating customer is a CRM, AI agent, workflow, API client, or software platform.

clear_items.title: Product routing is understandable
clear_items.detail: No list maps to target_discovery_pack_250, an existing list maps to score_pack_1k, and strong scored targets can progress to deep_analysis_pack_100 and then action_pack_25 after evidence gates.

clear_items.title: Safety boundary is explicit
clear_items.detail: External sending, writes, ledger operations, credit consumption, payment, customer creation, production keys, personal data, real lists, and human outreach are blocked.

residual_ambiguities.title: Single machine entrypoint
residual_ambiguities.detail: A future external evaluator should receive one canonical start file or URL.

residual_ambiguities.title: Simulated price versus live offer
residual_ambiguities.detail: A future machine buyer will need an explicit commercial_status field before any real transaction can exist.

residual_ambiguities.title: Thresholds for deeper products
residual_ambiguities.detail: The score-to-deep-analysis-to-action-pack path is understandable, but numerical thresholds should be stricter before external use.

next_test.name: owner_approval_gate_blind_machine_entrypoint_probe
next_test.description: Provide only the pack entrypoint to a separate machine evaluator and require it to identify the product, choose the correct product for three synthetic cases, list blocked actions, and produce only simulated purchase intent.
next_test.success_condition: The machine independently concludes that the pack is an externally presentable draft, but not yet distributable, sellable, or executable in production.
